title: TUR problem reports that are fixed
description: What tur-diag report fixed --json prints: the reports sent from this account that are fixed, either because the running image lists the report's code in /usr/share/tur/heal/fixes.json and the report was made on another build ('update'), or because the receiver said so at the last tur-diag report status ('receiver'). It reads only local files and sends nothing. The Rust type tur_diag::report::FixedList is authoritative and a test compares the two.

reported_on.description: The TUR version the report was made on.

change.description: The change that fixed it, from fixes.json.

rechecked_by_healing.description: The code is one of the self-healing catalogue: the healing service checks the fault again after the update and tells the person itself.
